newsitem.title: UK: U-Freight moves to new HQ in Frankfurt.
newsitem.headline: U-Freight moves to new HQ in Frankfurt.

text.p: U-Freight Alpha-Trans GmbH, the German unit of the international U-Freight logistics group, said on Monday it has become one of the first freight forwarders to relocate to the new dedicated cargo area at Frankfurt Airport -- Cargo City Sud.
In a statement released here, it says the new terminal includes 2,700 sq. ft of offices as well as 6,300 sq. ft. of warehousing, with an option to use additional space on a temporary basis if needed.

Gottfield Kraft, manager director of U-Freight Alpha-Trans said: "This move to larger and ultra-modern premises is a reflection of the continued expansion of our integrated logistics services which include air, sea and road freight forwarding, customs clearance and warehousing."
